risk_summary: The disclosure identifies meaningful exposure to customer credit risk, commodity-price volatility, impairment assumptions, insurance claims, litigation, and uncertain construction demand. While it provides some transaction details and goodwill-testing assumptions, many potential impacts remain dependent on management estimates and future conditions.
